pnacEnabled.description: Indicates whether the PNAC of MPP object is enabled or not.

audioCodecPriority.description: Choose up to three predefined codec priority options available for your region.

backlightTimer.description: Choose the length of time (in minutes) for the phone's backlight to remain on.

displayNameFormat.description: The display name that appears on the phone screen.

cdpEnabled.description: Allows you to enable/disable CDP for local devices.

defaultLoggingLevel.description: Choose the desired logging level for an MPP devices.

dndServicesEnabled.description: Enable/disable Do-Not-Disturb capabilities for Multi-Platform Phones.

shortInterdigitTimer.description: Indicates the short inter digit timer value.

longInterdigitTimer.description: Indicates the long inter digit timer value..

lineKeyLabelFormat.description: Line key labels define the format of what's shown next to line keys.

lineKeyLEDPattern.description: LED patterns define lighting schemes for the line keys on the MPP devices. Note that this parameter is not supported on the MPP 8875

lldpEnabled.description: Enable/disable Link Layer Discovery Protocol for local devices.

mppUserWebAccessEnabled.description: Enable/disable user-level access to the web interface of Multi-Platform Phones.

multicast.description: Select up to 10 Multicast Group URLs (each with a unique Listening Port).

enhancedMulticast.description: Specify the enhanced multicast settings for the MPP device.

offHookTimer.description: Specify the amount of time (in seconds) that a phone can remain off-hook.

phoneLanguage.description: Select the language for your MPP phone. Setting this overrides the default language setting in place for your provisioned location.

poeMode.description: Enable/disable the Power-Over-Ethernet mode for Multi-Platform Phones.

qosEnabled.description: Allows you to enable/disable tagging of packets from the local device to the Webex Calling platform.

screenTimeout.description: Specify the amount of inactive time needed (in seconds) before the phone's screen saver activates.

usbPortsEnabled.description: Enable/disable the use of the USB ports on Multi-Platform phones.

vlan.description: Specify a numeric Virtual LAN ID for devices.

wifiNetwork.description: Specify the Wi-Fi SSID and password for wireless-enabled MPP phones.

callHistory.description: Specify the call history information to use. Only applies to user devices.

contacts.description: Specify the directory services to use.

webexMeetingsEnabled.description: Enable/disable the availability of the webex meetings functionality from the phone.

volumeSettings.description: Specify all volume level values on the phone.

cfExpandedSoftKey.description: Specify the call forward expanded soft key behavior.

bluetooth.description: Enable/disable the visibility of the bluetooth menu on the MPP device.

passThroughPortEnabled.description: Enable/disable the use of the PC passthrough ethernet port on supported phone models.

userPasswordOverrideEnabled.description: Enable/disable the ability for an end user to set a local password on the phone to restrict local access to the device.

activeCallFocusEnabled.description: Enable/disable the default screen behavior when inbound calls are received.

noiseCancellation.description: Enable/disable local noise cancellation on active calls from the device.

voiceFeedbackAccessibilityEnabled.description: Enable/disable visibility of the Accessibility Voice Feedback menu on the MPP device.

dialAssistEnabled.description: Enable/disable availability of dial assist feature on the phone.

callsPerLine.description: Specify the number of calls per unique line appearance on the phone.

nightlyResyncEnabled.description: Enable/disable automatic nightly configuration resync of the MPP device.

missedCallNotificationEnabled.description: Enable/disable the visual indication of missed calls.

softKeyLayout.description: Specify the softkey layout per phone menu state.

backgroundImage8875.description: Specify the image option for the MPP 8875 phone background.

backlightTimer68XX78XX.description: Specify the use of the backlight feature on 6800 nad 7800 series devices.

allowMonitorLinesEnabled.description: Enable/disable monitoring for MPP non-primary device.

iceEnabled.description: Enable/disable SIP media streams to go directly between phones on the same local network.
